$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

tapMs.description: How long the perfect and human bots hold a tap, in ms; must stay under `feel.input.holdMinMs` so the tap is a Parry.

reactionMeanMs.description: Mean time the human bot needs to react to a sight or a signal, in ms: its press is never before the telegraph plus a draw around this.

reactionSdMs.description: Standard deviation of that reaction time, in ms (Gaussian, one draw per response; 0 takes no draw).

reactionMinMs.description: Shortest reaction time the human bot can draw, in ms: nobody reacts faster.

offsetMs.description: Where the human bot aims relative to the window's centre on this display, in ms (negative = early, 0 = dead centre).

sdMs.description: Standard deviation of the human bot's press (or release) around that aim, in ms (Gaussian); capped so that a press stays in its cycle.

withChronoRing.description: The chrono-ring is shown (the game always shows it since story 2.11).

offsetMs.description: Where the human bot aims relative to the window's centre on this display, in ms (negative = early, 0 = dead centre).

sdMs.description: Standard deviation of the human bot's press (or release) around that aim, in ms (Gaussian); capped so that a press stays in its cycle.

withoutChronoRing.description: The chrono-ring is hidden (the conditions of the 2026-11-03 playtest: `npm run sim -- --chrono-ring off`).

readError.description: The timing error of a press on a parry or a Firmness, by what the player is shown.

aimOffsetMs.description: Where the human bot aims on a rhythm or a signal with no chrono-ring (beats, wait, breath), in ms (negative = early, 0 = dead centre).

jitterSdMs.description: Standard deviation of the human bot's press on a rhythm or a signal, in ms (Gaussian).

missWhileBusyPct.description: Chance, in %, that the human bot never answers a threat it first sees while busy elsewhere (finger down, another press planned, Papa asleep, drinking, on the phone or on the toilet); 0 = never.

human.description: The `human` bot: a plausible attentive player.

actionsPerSec.description: How many actions the random bot starts per second of sim time, on average.

floorReachM.description: How far from Papa the random bot may tap on the floor, in metres.

maxHoldMs.description: Longest the random bot holds a press, in ms; above `feel.input.holdMinMs` so that it also produces Firmness.

random.description: The `random` bot: a fuzzer that exercises every command.

description: Settings of the automatic players used by `npm run sim` and the autoplay.
